material_states.name: Charge PbBr2 and1-octadecene in2L three-neck reactor
Heat PbBr2/octadecene to120°C under vacuum for1h
Inject dried oleylamine and oleic acid to dissolve PbBr2
Meanwhile dissolve cesium carbonate and oleic acid in octadecene
Transfer Cs-oleate solution to warmed addition funnel
Remove mantle, briefly evacuate reactor, then close vacuum valve
Open funnel stopcock to inject warm Cs-oleate feed
Terminate5s after injection with an ice-water bath
Redissolve precipitate with hexane/ligands; precipitate with acetone
Disperse in a nonpolar solvent; exact identity and volume not specified
